Maria: Morning—async standup on NovaCare adoption/escalation. Webhooks failing ~10% since yesterday 22:40 UTC. Collected samples & raised ticket #4451. Blockers: need eng to confirm whether routing rollback to v3 or routing to a quantized variant helps; also need cache warm. Today: coordinate with AE, prepare rollback/canary plan if eng confirms.

Maria: sample error (redacted):
```
{"req_id":"nc-2026-03-16-8753","status":"error","code":502,"msg":"upstream model timeout", "lat_ms":8200}
```

AJ: saw this — likely KV cache eviction + higher tail latency on that model pool. I can bump model timeout by +5s and open a hotfix. Quick ask: can you paste the full req_id from the logs? Ping @Olivia for cache warm.

Maria: req_id is nc-2026-03-16-8753 (added full log to ticket). Also added sample payload and timestamps.

Olivia: I can run a cache warm for NovaCare's pool now (15m window). Suggest routing 5% traffic to v2-quant as a fallback while we stabilize — lower perf but more stable under memory pressure. @AJ if you bump timeout I can start warm and the canary.

Sam: FYI renewal touchpoint on Tues EOD — if this drags into Monday execs get looped. Need mitigation by EOD Fri ideally.

Lee: I'll create a 5% canary to v2-quant and wire up the smoke check. Will monitor errors & latency for next 30m. Need the pool name — Maria?

Maria: pool name is nova-prod-us-west-1. Added to ticket.

AJ: opened PR #1274 to bump timeout + add feature-flagged rollback. Marked as hotfix. @Olivia @Lee please review quick.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/1274 -> staging in ~8m, prod rollout after canary passes.

Maria: thanks all — I'll update customer-facing note and CS playbook. Will post a follow-up in this thread after canary results.
